component.name: ADI-2 Control
component.summary: Remote and EQ for RME ADI-2 DACs

description.p: A native remote control and EQ builder for the RME ADI-2 DAC, ADI-2 Pro and ADI-2/4 Pro, built on RME's published MIDI protocol. It is independent software and is not affiliated with or endorsed by RME.

ul.li: Every output, input and device setting over USB MIDI, synced both ways
Graphical 5-band parametric EQ with a live response curve
Imports Equalizer APO, REW, AutoEq and Squiglink EQ files
Shareable local JSON EQ profiles, and offline editing without a DAC
Watches for the DAC and reconnects when it is switched on

description.p: Turn on MIDI Control in the ADI-2's setup menu and connect it by USB.

screenshot.caption: Graphical EQ for the phones output

description.p: Store builds leave out the on-device preset and setup memory controls, which are not yet hardware-qualified.
Uses the same app icon as ADI-2 Companion for Mac, and ships as a Debian package and a snap.
